subject: sudden problems deploying shiny app from spark.studio

messages.author: 26fecb150d87828f
messages.subject: sudden problems deploying shiny app from spark.studio
parts:
Hello, 

I built a fairly simple shiny app last year that works like a charm offline and placed it on spark.studio for its online hosting here: http://spark.rstudio.com/veromora/BiocharEng/. It was working perfectly well up to last week and I cannot figure out what the sudden problem is. It appears that the workspace (now called Environment) is not loading for whatever reason, as the graphic, table, and stats tabs depend on objects and functions located there. I tried downloading the ui.R, server.R, and workingspace.rda files to test that they still work offline and they do. I originally had the .Rprofile file in the home directory set to load the workingspace.rda file in spark.studio, and am wondering if this should now be located elsewhere. Any guidance would be greatly appreciated to get this back up and running. 

Best,

Veronica

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: sudden problems deploying shiny app from spark.studio
parts:
Veronica,

I am assuming you are using RStudio locally, and it is working for you there; right? RStudio searches your current directory for .Rprofile, and if that is not found then the .Rprofile file in your home directory is used. (As described in this document). 

Based on this document, when an R process starts, it should do the same thing (of course there are other environment settings that could affect this behavior).

In my own environment I see that if a .Rprofile file is in my current/application directory, then everything works fine, but not when it is in my home directory. So as a workaround, you could create the .Rprofile file in your application directory. 

Best,
Fereshteh
